resolution.question: Will Amara's coworkers respect her more by the end of the quarter?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if, by the hard cutoff, there is observable evidence (e.g., a coworker explicitly states increased respect, Amara receives a promotion or positive performance review citing respect, or a reliable survey or feedback mechanism records higher respect) that Amara's coworkers respect her more than at the start. Otherwise resolve NO.
